title: Fix AMDGPU system freezes or reboots when idle
summary: Resolve random crashes or reboots during idle or sleep by disabling GFXOFF via kernel parameters.
error_patterns: system freezes or reboots when idle

steps.explain: Add the kernel parameter amdgpu.ppfeaturemask=0xffff7fff to disable GFXOFF.
steps.gui: Edit your bootloader configuration (e.g., GRUB) to add 'amdgpu.ppfeaturemask=0xffff7fff' to the kernel command line.

rollback.explain: Remove the kernel parameter from the bootloader configuration.
rollback.gui: Edit your bootloader configuration to remove 'amdgpu.ppfeaturemask=0xffff7fff'.

warnings: This disables a power-saving feature (GFXOFF), which may increase idle power consumption.
